title: Placement of Long-Lead Removal Credits in Design Studio Selections Option Deposits
content:
**Posting rule.** On a Design Studio Selections file, the long-lead removal credits are the removal credits booked on cabinetry and countertop lines while the agreement's construction stage was foundation or framing, whenever those lines were added. They are placed as follows:

1. where long-lead removal credits exist and cabinetry or countertop lines were also added while the construction stage was foundation or framing, the removed item counts as replaced: its credits are deducted from neither the long-lead group nor the finish group, and the long-lead group is the added lines alone;
2. where long-lead removal credits exist but no such line was added at those stages, the credits are deducted from the finish group and not from the long-lead group;
3. otherwise the long-lead removal credits are deducted from the long-lead group.

The long-lead group is the cabinetry and countertop lines added while the construction stage was foundation or framing; the finish group holds the other finish lines.

**Records read.** The category and the construction stage on each removal entry and each selection entry.

**Cases on hypothetical figures**

| Long-lead lines added at foundation or framing | Long-lead removal credits | Long-lead group | Credits taken from the finish group |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6000.00 | 2000.00 | 6000.00 | None |
| None | 2000.00 | 0.00 | 2000.00 |
| 6000.00 | None | 6000.00 | None |
